data.narrative:
Axelera AI is a Series C semiconductor chip design company that has raised $450M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 8 private peers in the chips and semiconductors sector—including Tenstorrent, Positron AI, and DEEPX at comparable or adjacent funding stages—alongside 3 public semiconductor benchmarks (ALAB, NVDA, AMD).

Two methods triangulate on valuation. Stage-progression applies a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical of Series C advancement to the $450M raised proxy, implying $765M. Peer-median anchors to the median valuation of three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables at $1.0B, with the peer range spanning $529M (DEEPX, Series C) to $2.7B (Tenstorrent, Series D). Public-comp anchoring via P/S multiples (median 20.5x across the three public tickers) cannot be applied absent revenue disclosure, common for private companies at this stage.

The triangulated range is $650M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $882M. This reflects the gap between stage-progression ($765M) and peer-median ($1.0B). Key uncertainties center on revenue traction, which would unlock public-comp validation, and the appropriate weighting of the peer set given heterogeneity in funding stage and market position across Tenstorrent, Positron AI, and DEEPX.
